decision.gate_fail: Reject this scenario contract or replace one causally identified market-state assumption. Do not perform a return-targeted threshold sweep.
decision.gate_pass: Authorize a byte-frozen fresh-validation candidate. This is not a success claim.

decision_evidence: one continuous NautilusTrader account/state timeline per 28-day block
economic-cluster expectancy rather than isolated trade or week point estimates
natural target, stop or predeclared one-cycle time exit
after-cost NAV growth with safety and exact-risk audits

DEVELOPMENT_GATE.advance_means: authorize a byte-frozen fresh-validation candidate only
DEVELOPMENT_GATE.minimum_contract: three precommitted continuous 28-day blocks and economic-cluster robustness
purpose: estimate scenario-domain event quality and density on continuous opened data
decide whether fresh validation is worth spending

FRESH_VALIDATION.can_claim_alpha: only after the separate fresh-validation protocol passes
purpose: test the frozen scenario once on untouched continuous blocks
measure durability, rolling growth and regime transitions after fresh validation

importance_contract.primary_object: A causal trading scenario: completed liquidity pool, sweep, completed peer transfer, local reclaim/displacement, executable entry, structural invalidation, live target and one-cycle time invalidation.
importance_contract.primary_research_priority: Discover and improve a causally coherent after-cost trading scenario. Backtest return, win rate and trade count are consequences and diagnostics, not variables to be forced by adding conditions.
temporary_tests: single-block smoke runs used only to find implementation or state-order defects
diagnostic ablations on already opened data
temporary_tests_cannot: promote an interval to holdout evidence
justify threshold additions merely because NAV improves

research_question: Can the SCDAM core failed-auction transfer mechanism, evaluated as its own scenario domain rather than pooled with AAC or session-I7 routes, produce repeatable after-cost account growth across continuous opened-data blocks?

scenario_contract.detector: Candidate 11 SCDAM regional handoff auction engine
scenario_contract.exclusion_reason: Opened evidence does not support pooling these economically different states under one account-level claim. They require independent scenario contracts and evidence.

time_invalidation.semantics: A failed-auction transfer must resolve within one complete 24-hour global liquidity cycle; otherwise the original causal episode is stale.

selection.method: Before downloading market data, enumerate every daily 28-day start from 2022-01-01 through 2025-12-04, shuffle with random.Random(seed), exclude each W10-W14/H1-H3 interval together with its three-day warmup, then accept the first three non-overlapping starts from distinct calendar years. The selected intervals are intentionally opened as development data and can never become validation evidence.
